biography: Ritesh Rai grew up in the bustling streets of Mumbai, where the chaotic traffic sparked an early fascination with speed. He began his racing journey with local karting events, quickly displaying a natural talent for aggressive overtaking maneuvers. His raw talent caught the eye of a VW Virtus GTS team scout during a national championship, leading to his professional debut at the age of 23. Ritesh faced initial struggles adapting to the higher speeds and technical nuances of circuit racing, but his relentless determination saw him steadily improve. A defining moment came during the Goa Grand Prix, where he fearlessly battled seasoned veterans to secure a podium finish. Currently, Ritesh is considered a rising star in the Indian motorsport scene, focused on honing his skills and making a mark on the international stage. He balances his racing career with promoting grassroots motorsport initiatives in his hometown.
drivingStyle: Ritesh Rai is known for his relentlessly aggressive driving style. He favors late braking and daring overtakes, often pushing his car and tires to the absolute limit. While his aggressive approach sometimes leads to mistakes, it also allows him to extract maximum performance from his machine. He thrives under pressure, relishing wheel-to-wheel battles and demonstrating remarkable composure in high-stakes situations. Tire management is an area he's actively working on, learning to balance his attacking instincts with the need for long-run consistency.
